scripts.build: npm run build -w @fleet/shared && npm run build -w @fleet/api && npm run build -w @fleet/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fleet/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @fleet/shared && tsx --test tests-app/costing.test.ts tests-app/operations.test.ts tests-app/period.test.ts tests-app/income.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @fleet/shared && npm run build -w @fleet/api && tsx --test tests-app/*integration.test.ts
